Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: In Step 6, the Planner incorrectly interpreted the metadata from the PBS webpage. The metadata description clearly stated: "Ingmar Bergman, a titan of modern cinema, died Monday in his home on the island of **Fårö**, Sweden." However, the Planner erroneously claimed the text indicated he died in "**Faro, Portugal**." This is a hallucination of the location (confusing the Swedish island Fårö with the Portuguese city Faro) that led the subsequent reasoning to pivot towards an incorrect solution (Faro, Portugal) instead of the correct one (Fårö, Sweden).
